---
title: "How to contribute data"
---

Please contact Sam Yeaman ([samuel.yeaman\@ucalgary.ca](mailto:samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca)) for detailed instructions on contributing.

## Do you have a dataset that you think might contribute to the RepAdapt group?

Take this quick quiz to see if it fits our inclusion criteria!

```{=html}
<div id="quiz"></div>
<button id="quiz-submit">See my result</button>
<div id="quiz-result"></div>

<script>
// ---- 1. Your questions ----
const QUESTIONS = [
  { id: "q1", text: "Are your species sampled from the wild (or agricultural context), or from captivity if originally collected in the wild with a known location of origin?", type: "yesno" },
  { id: "q2", text: "Does your dataset include at least 20 individuals with low relatedness and have a high quality reference genome (chromosome scale scaffolds, or nearly that scale)?",      type: "yesno" },
  { id: "q3", text: "Does your datasets include at total of at least 100 individuals from at least 5 populations spanning an environmental gradient.",
    type: "yesno" },
  { id: "q4", text: "Is your sequencing method one of the following:  Whole Genome Shotgun (WGS) sequencing, pooled population sequencing, or targeted sequencing of the exome?",       type: "yesno" },
  { id: "q5", text: "Is your coverage >3x?", type: "yesno"},
  
  // ...up to q10
];

// ---- 2. Where answers get stored ----
const answers = {};

// ---- 3. Build the questions on the page ----
const container = document.getElementById("quiz");

QUESTIONS.forEach((q, i) => {
  const opts = (q.type === "yesno") ? ["Yes", "No"] : q.options;

  const block = document.createElement("div");
  block.className = "quiz-q";
  block.innerHTML = "<p><strong>" + (i + 1) + ".</strong> " + q.text + "</p>";

  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "quiz-opts";

  opts.forEach(opt => {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.textContent = opt;
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      answers[q.id] = opt;
      row.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("selected"));
      btn.classList.add("selected");
    });
    row.appendChild(btn);
  });

  block.appendChild(row);
  container.appendChild(block);
});

// ---- 4. Decide the final message ----
function resultMessage(a) {
  const missing = QUESTIONS.filter(q => !(q.id in a)).length;
  if (missing > 0) {
    return "Please answer all " + QUESTIONS.length + " questions (" + missing + " left).";
  }

  // Specific answers that override everything else, checked first:
  if (a.q1 === "No")        return "You're not eligible: The species must be wild.";
  if (a.q2 === "No" && a.q3 === "No" || a.q4 === "No") return "You're not eligible.";
  if (a.q2 === "Yes" && a.q3 === "Yes" && a.q5 === "No") return "You're data is eligible for analysis of selective sweeps or genotype-environment associations using the low coverage pipeline! Email Sam Yeaman at samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca for further instructions.";
  if (a.q2 === "Yes" && a.q3 === "Yes" && a.q5 === "Yes") return "You're data is eligible for analysis of selective sweeps or genotype-environment associations using the conventional pipeline! Email Sam Yeaman at samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca for further instructions.";
  
  if (a.q1 === "Yes" && a.q2 === "Yes" && a.q3 === "No" && a.q4 === "Yes" && a.q5 === "Yes") return "You're data is eligible for analysis of selective sweeps using the conventional pipeline! Email Sam Yeaman at samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca for further instructions."; 
  if (a.q1 === "Yes" && a.q2 === "Yes" && a.q3 === "No" && a.q4 === "Yes" && a.q5 === "No") return "You're data is eligible for analysis of selective sweeps using the low coverage pipeline! Email Sam Yeaman at samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca for further instructions.";
  
  if (a.q1 === "Yes" && a.q2 === "No" && a.q3 === "Yes" && a.q4 === "Yes" && a.q5 === "Yes") return "You're data is eligible for analysis of genotype-environment associations using the conventional pipeline! Email Sam Yeaman at samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca for further instructions.";
  if (a.q1 === "Yes" && a.q2 === "No" && a.q3 === "Yes" && a.q4 === "Yes" && a.q5 === "No") return "You're data is eligible for analysis of genotype-environment associations using the low coverage pipeline! Email Sam Yeaman at samuel.yeaman@ucalgary.ca for further instructions.";
  
  // Otherwise fall back to a count of "Yes" answers:
  const yesCount = Object.values(a).filter(v => v === "Yes").length;
  
}

// ---- 5. Wire up the button ----
document.getElementById("quiz-submit").addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.getElementById("quiz-result").textContent = resultMessage(answers);
});
</script>
```
